fusions.name: Archer's Heave
fusions.desc: Draws back for 1 second and hurls the axe for 26 damage that ignores armour, rising to 2 times that damage at its full 9 tile reach.

fusions.name: Loosed Three
fusions.desc: Looses 3 hatchets at once in a narrow spread, each dealing 3 damage. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Long Arm
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
